transcript: Don't start vibe coding with Claude Code unless you've installed these four plugins. The third is Graphify, which turns your entire codebase into a knowledge graph. So, your agent doesn't have to waste tokens by re-reading files again and again. And finally, there's Agent Skills, which is a pack of 24 skills that let you vibe code like a real senior engineer, built by the former AI engineering director at Google. It has dedicated skills for planning, coding, testing, and publishing, and it activates the right one at the specific stages of coding it needs all on its own. So, if you want to try them all out for yourselves, just comment "coding" and I'll send the link to you directly.
